author: feral-core
description: Run long-horizon work autonomously in the background. Use this when the user asks you to 'go work on', 'spend some time', 'keep working until', or otherwise take on a multi-step job that won't finish in a single reply. The task survives the user navigating away AND a brain restart, and each step runs with a generous tool budget. Then check progress with status/list.
trigger_phrases: work on this for a while
run this as a background task

endpoints.description: Start a persistent background task. Use `goal` for a single autonomous job, or `subtasks` (an ordered list) to break a larger goal into steps that run sequentially in the background. Each step is an autonomous agent turn with the full tool budget (up to ~15 minutes of work). Returns a flow_id you can use with `status`. Tell the user the task started and that you'll keep working; do NOT claim it's finished.

params.name: goal
params.description: Natural-language description of the single background job, e.g. 'research the top 5 competitors and summarize each'. Provide this OR subtasks.

params.name: subtasks
params.description: Ordered list of sub-goals to run one after another in the background. Use for multi-stage work so progress is checkpointed between stages.

params.name: title
params.description: Short human-readable title for the task list UI.

endpoints.description: Check progress of a background task by flow_id. Use this when the user asks how a task is going.
endpoints.returns_description: {flow_id, title, status, current_step, steps_total, steps_completed, error}

endpoints.description: List recent background tasks and their statuses.
